pet_atlas.prompt: Create exactly twelve distinct, believable shelter pet portraits in an exact equal-size 4-column by 3-row, full-bleed contact sheet: Labrador mix, orange domestic shorthair, rabbit, guinea pig, senior beagle, German shepherd, border collie, Chihuahua, calico, tuxedo cat, tabby, and Maine Coon.
